name: open-computer-use
description: Visual-first macOS Computer Use MCP that observes real screenshots and sends real CoreGraphics input events.

interface.longDescription: Uses real macOS screenshots as the UI source of truth, renders a visible virtual cursor, and sends real CoreGraphics mouse, keyboard, paste, and scroll events without reading DOM or Accessibility UI trees.
defaultPrompt: Call observe_screen before acting and treat the latest screenshot as the UI source of truth
Call move_mouse and visually verify the virtual cursor hotspot before every click
Verify the fresh screenshot returned after every action before continuing

permissions.reason: Launch the installed Visual Computer Use stdio MCP executable.
Send user-requested mouse, keyboard, paste, and scroll events to macOS applications.
